name: EP3Oil, Inc.
summary: EP3Oil, Inc. specializes in developing and providing secondary oil recovery well opportunities for investors. Their operational scope is extensive, encompassing critical upstream oil and gas activities like hydraulic fracturing and enhanced oil recovery techniques, alongside exploration and production. The company also handles oil and gas marketing, and its portfolio further diversifies into renewable energy solutions and thermal power generation. EP3Oil, Inc. is headquartered in Plant City, Florida.
